snippet.title: Ketika Ibu Hanya Ingin Sedikit Perhatian
snippet.description:
Kisah ini menceritakan tentang Farel dan Laura yang mulai menyadari bahwa selama ini mereka terlalu terbiasa menerima bantuan dan pengorbanan ibu. Mereka sering meminta berbagai hal tanpa memikirkan bahwa seorang ibu juga bisa merasa lelah dan membutuhkan waktu untuk beristirahat.

Ketika Siti akhirnya memilih untuk beristirahat, Farel dan Laura mulai merasakan sendiri betapa banyak pekerjaan rumah yang selama ini dilakukan oleh ibu mereka. Dari pengalaman tersebut, mereka belajar memahami arti kepedulian, kasih sayang, dan menghargai pengorbanan seorang ibu.

Pesan moral: Jangan pernah menganggap pengorbanan seorang ibu sebagai kewajiban yang harus selalu dilakukan. Ibu juga manusia yang bisa lelah, ingin beristirahat, dan membutuhkan perhatian. Hargailah kasih sayang dan keberadaan ibu selagi masih ada kesempatan.

snippet.title: Phoebe doesn’t make the cheerleading team.🤣 #movie #tv  #funny
snippet.description:
Phoebe and Cherry sign up for cheerleading tryouts together. They perform side by side and promise they will both make the team. Only Cherry gets accepted, while Phoebe is rejected. Phoebe is swallowed up by jealousy. She cannot bring herself to say “congratulations” — the words get stuck in her throat. Cherry notices and feels hurt 📣.

Later, Phoebe overhears the other cheerleaders plotting to prank Cherry. During the pre‑game rally performance, they plan to make Cherry wear the rival team’s colors. Then the mascot will crack a slime‑filled fake egg over her head to humiliate her in front of everyone. Phoebe hurries to warn Cherry and tells her not to take part in the show.
But Cherry thinks Phoebe is just bitter about not making the team and making up lies to stir trouble. They have a huge fight, fall out, and even delete each other’s photos and contacts from their phones.

On the day of the performance, Phoebe cannot stand by and watch her best friend get publicly embarrassed. She puts on the mascot costume and sneaks onto the field. Right before the prank happens, she smashes the slime egg on the head of the cheer captain who planned everything, instead of Cherry.
Cherry realizes then that Phoebe was telling the truth. Phoebe was not just jealous — she was truly worried about her.

After the show, Cherry apologizes to Phoebe for assuming she was only acting out of envy. Phoebe admits she did feel jealous, but she never wanted to see Cherry get pranked. They clear up the misunderstanding and make up. They learn that jealousy can be a real feeling, but their friendship matters more. Phoebe is willing to set aside her disappointment to protect Cherry 🤍

snippet.title: ശാരദാമ്മയെ കുടുക്കാൻ നോക്കി സ്വയം കുടുങ്ങി🤣 #carrothalwa
snippet.description:
Homemade Carrot Halwa🧡🥕

Ingredients

* Fresh carrots
* Ghee
* Milk
* Sugar (as per taste)
* Crushed cashew nuts
* Crushed almonds

How to Prepare

* Wash the carrots thoroughly, cut off both ends, and peel off the skin.
* Grate the carrots finely using a grater.
* Heat ghee in a pan.
* Once the ghee is hot, add the grated carrots and sauté well.
* After sautéing for a few minutes, pour in the milk and mix well.
* Cover the pan with a lid and cook on medium flame for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the carrots are well cooked.
* Once the carrots are cooked, add sugar as per your desired sweetness.
* Mix everything well and continue cooking until the mixture thickens and starts leaving the sides of the pan.
* Finally, add crushed cashew nuts and almonds on top and mix gently.

Delicious Carrot Halwa is ready to serve!🥕

Enjoy! ❤️🧡

snippet.title: Zelenskiy: Rossiya neft qayta işlaş quvvatining 55 foizi töxtatildi | Ukrainaga bosqin
snippet.description:
Ukraina prezidenti Vladimir Zelenskiy Rossiya neft qayta işlaş quvvatlarining 55 foizini töxtatişga muvaffaq bölinganini bildirdi. Ukraina dronlari Tatarstondagi yirik neft majmualariga zarba berdi. Rostov viloyatining Azov şahrida ham hujumlardan keyin yonğinlar qayd etildi.

Zelenskiy AQŞ bilan tinçlik muzokaralarida Ukrainaga NATO a’zoligi evaziga Donbassdan çiqiş masalasi kötarilganini aytdi. Ukraina prezidenti öz qöşinlarini Donbassdan olib çiqmasligini va mamlakat hududlaridan voz keçmasligini ta’kidladi.

Rossiyaning «Moskovskiy komsomoles» gazetasi Zelenskiy va Ukraina harbiy rahbariyatini yöq qilişga qöyilgan ehtimoliy norasmiy taqiq olib taşlangani haqida yozdi. Naşr noma’lum Telegram kanallariga tayangan. Bu da’vo mustaqil tasdiqlanmagan.

Ukraina prezidenti AQŞning Starşield sun’iy yöldoş aloqa tizimidagi tezlik çeklovlari Rossiyaning reaktiv dronlariga qarşi kuraşni qiyinlaştirayotganini bildirdi.
